tools.name: search_docs
tools.title: Search Documentation
tools.description:
Search Better Auth documentation and return matching snippets.

Use this tool when you need to:
- Find setup guides for authentication providers (email, OAuth, passkeys)
- Look up plugin configuration (two-factor, admin, organization)
- Find API references for client or server methods
- Troubleshoot errors or configuration issues

<examples>
- "session management" → finds docs about session handling, expiration, refresh
- "two-factor" → finds two-factor authentication plugin setup
- "nextjs middleware" → finds Next.js integration guides
Bad queries: avoid single generic words like 'auth' or 'config' — be specific.
</examples>

<hints>
- Resolve an explicit or installed Better Auth version with get_doc(path="/llms.txt") before searching.
- Treat version identifiers from /llms.txt as opaque values; do not infer their format.
- If the project version is unavailable, omit version to search the latest documentation.
- Returns snippets only. Use get_doc(path) to read the full page content.
- Pass the result path to get_doc unchanged so it reads the same documentation version.
- Results are grouped by page — one result per documentation page.
- IMPORTANT: Do not call this tool more than 3 times per question.
</hints>

query.description: Search query. Can be a concept, plugin name, API method, or error message.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-20, default 5)

version.description: Documentation version identifier listed in /llms.txt. When project files are available, resolve the installed better-auth version before searching. Use "latest" only when the project version is unavailable.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.title: Get Document
tools.description:
Get Better Auth documentation content. Returns the latest documentation index if no path is provided, or the full content for a specific page or version index.

Use this tool when you need to:
- Browse all pages in the latest documentation (call without path)
- Read the complete guide for a specific topic found via search_docs
- Get code examples and configuration details for a feature

<examples>
get_doc() → returns the latest documentation index (/docs/llms.txt)
get_doc(path="/llms.txt") → returns the index of available documentation versions
get_doc(path="/docs/concepts/session-management") → full session management guide
get_doc(path="/docs/plugins/2fa") → two-factor authentication plugin docs
</examples>

<hints>
- Call without path to browse the latest documentation.
- Use path="/llms.txt" to match a user-specified or installed Better Auth version to a supported documentation version.
- Use search_docs before fetching a page — do not guess documentation paths.
- Versioned paths returned by search_docs are supported.
- Anchors and a trailing .md suffix are accepted, but the full page is returned.
</hints>

path.description: Documentation page or index path (e.g. /docs/concepts/session-management). Use versioned paths returned by search_docs as-is, or /llms.txt to list available versions. Omit to get the latest documentation index.
